config.affine_control: Added after initial finite results and held-out affine coefficient check; frozen fits from discovery only. Original conditions and gates retained.

hypotheses.replay: Saved native write replacement matches independent full forward logits with maximum absolute error <= 0.02.
hypotheses.finite_dynamic: Rank-64 input decoder achieves >= 0.80 full-logit fidelity relative to replacing the four coefficients by their discovery means in at least three layers.
hypotheses.nonlinear_value: Rank-16 decoder beats exact mean-state linear decoder by >= 0.10 dynamic full-logit fidelity in at least two early/middle layers.
hypotheses.binding: Rank-64 decoder beats a frozen row permutation of its predictions by >= 0.10 dynamic full-logit fidelity in every layer.
hypotheses.beats_fitted_affine: Rank-64 decoder beats fitted affine readout by >= 0.05 dynamic full-logit fidelity in at least two early/middle layers. Added before affine finite evaluation.

config.scope: Four fixed output axes per layer; intact orthogonal write remainder for primary causal tests. Report projected-only full-MLP coverage separately. Dynamic-effect denominator replaces coefficients with discovery means. Zero-component denominator also reported. No target labels enter decoder. Includes axes with weak individual recurrence: L8 axes2/3 and L12 axes1/2; do not describe all axes as independently stable.
